# lean-pkg lease renew

restart your own live lease from now (holder-only; refuses once it has lapsed: claim again).

Also spelled: `lean-pkg renew` ([all aliases](aliases.md)).

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg lease renew --agent AGENT [--ttl HOURS] [--workspace WORKSPACE]
                     [--reason REASON] [--contact TEXT] [--no-contact] [common flags]
                     NAME
```

`[common flags]`: `--json`, `--commit`, `--push`, `--no-commit`, also accepted before the command name; see the [CLI overview](../cli.md).

## Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |   |
| `--agent AGENT` | Required. |
| `--ttl HOURS` | new TTL, 1..8760 (default: the lease's current ttl_hours; above 8760: exit 2) |
| `--workspace WORKSPACE` | move the lease to this workspace |
| `--reason REASON` |   |
| `--contact TEXT` | set or replace the lease's contact (address of the holding session; one line, at most 200 characters); without it the lease keeps its contact |
| `--no-contact` | clear the lease's contact while renewing (not with --contact) |

## Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `renew NAME` | restart your own live lease from now (event `claim-refreshed`); refuses when there is no lease, another agent holds it, or it has already lapsed (claim again; `audit --fix` sweeps it). `--contact TEXT` sets or replaces the lease's contact (same rules as `claim`); without it the contact is kept; `--no-contact` clears it (the `claim-refreshed` event then records `contact_cleared: true` when a contact was removed; no contact: nothing to clear); `--contact` with `--no-contact` exits 2 with nothing written; `--ttl` is 1 to 8760 hours, a larger value exits 2 with nothing written | `--agent A` `[--ttl HOURS]` `[--workspace W]` `[--reason]` `[--contact TEXT]` `[--no-contact]` |

## JSON output

Top-level keys of `--json`, as recorded in the golden contract (tests/golden/json-keys.json):

- `renew` (exit 0): `event`, `expires_at`, `lease`, `name`, `ok`

## Examples

Restart your own live lease from now; once it has lapsed, claim again.

```bash
lean-pkg lease renew my-proof --agent alice
```
